claim: Measure whether the corrected ACK-known-task guard changes frozen-policy execution relative to the matched historical R control.

primary_metric.name: parent_macro_guard_minus_R_utility
primary_metric.repeat_aggregation: mean of the three repeats within each parent
primary_metric.confidence_interval: two-sided 95% parent-cluster bootstrap; resample the eight parent aggregates with replacement
primary_metric.tie_rule: abs(raw paired utility difference) <= 1e-6 is a descriptive tie; primary mean and bootstrap retain unrounded values

outputs: paired secondary metrics and technical-stop accounting
analysis_implementation.execution_contract: pure standard-library JSONL analysis; no environment, model, checkpoint, or budget writes

state_contract.public_legal: action is legal under the current public mask or continuation_actions
state_contract.execution_accepted: native env.step feedback accepts the action
state_contract.completed: native task/completion records and terminal counts report completion
state_contract.host_confirmation: native completion_records or task_outcome only; never reconstructed from model output

pre_execution_gates: same-ledger limit extension to 404 is approved and verified on the controlled ledger
new run and attempt identities are absent
unknown and pending reservations are zero
all source, checkpoint, snapshot, manifest, protocol, and control evidence hashes match
historical R control binding passes the frozen schema/identity/time bridge-qualified policy for all 24 pairs
no Python or PythonW process is already running for this experiment
runtime_stop_rules: any identity, mask, probability, hidden-state, or snapshot digest mismatch
any invalid action or unlogged continuation submission
any environment, model, reward, serialization, or budget error
any duplicate, missing, partial, or nonterminal branch output
protocol step cap is reached before native termination
interpretation_limits: This is eval-only and does not train GPPO or update the world model.
A guard-R difference is not an algorithmic gain without the frozen-source and control gates.
No negative result may be retried or selectively omitted.
H-004 bridges historical R identity only; current authorization entry now recomputes that bridge. A guard-versus-R result cannot establish an independent GPPO or world-model contribution.
required_final_outputs: 24 new guard branch records paired to 24 trusted historical R control records
parent-level repeat means and eight-parent macro aggregate
parent-cluster 95% confidence interval for primary guard-minus-R utility
secondary paired outcome table and technical-stop accounting
decision on whether the simple execution-state baseline is fixed for the next study

decision_rule.improvement_evidence: primary parent-bootstrap lower bound > 0; explicitly report whether task_unavailable decreased and task completion/energy tradeoffs
decision_rule.uncertain: primary CI contains zero, including exact null; no post-hoc preference change
decision_rule.fix_as_required_simple_baseline: Only if primary improvement is supported, invalid duplicate submissions decrease, and mean task completion does not decline; otherwise retain as tested comparator and do not mandate it as the new baseline. Technical stop never qualifies as a research result.
